gcode_macro _pre_scan_tool_changes.gcode:
{% set path = printer.virtual_sdcard.path ~ '/' ~ printer.print_stats.filename %}
DYNAMIC_MACRO MACRO=_PRE_SCAN_TOOL_CHANGES {rawparams}

gcode_macro set_pause_next_layer.description: Enable a pause if the next layer is reached

gcode_macro set_pause_at_layer.description: Enable/disable a pause if a given layer number is reached

gcode_macro set_print_stats_info.description: Overwrite, to get pause_next_layer and pause_at_layer feature

gcode_macro _toolhead_park_pause_cancel.description: Helper: park toolhead used in PAUSE and CANCEL_PRINT

gcode_macro _client_extrude.description: Extrudes, if the extruder is hot enough

gcode_macro _client_retract.description: Retracts, if the extruder is hot enough

gcode_macro _client_linear_move.description: Linear move with save and restore of the gcode state

gcode_macro line_purge.description: A purge macro that adapts to be near your actual printed objects

gcode_macro voron_purge.description: A purge macro that adapts to be near your actual printed objects

gcode_macro smart_park.description: Parks your printhead near the print area for pre-print hotend heating.

gcode_macro _kamp_settings.gcode: {action_respond_info(" Running the KAMP_Settings macro does nothing, it is only used for storing KAMP settings. ")}
gcode_macro _kamp_settings.description: This macro contains all adjustable settings for KAMP

gcode_macro start_print.gcode:
_PRE_SCAN_TOOL_CHANGES
{% set BED_TEMP = params.BED_TEMP|default(60)|float %}
{% set EXTRUDER_TEMP = params.EXTRUDER_TEMP|default(210)|float %}
{% set EXTRUDER_STANDBY_TEMP = EXTRUDER_TEMP - 30 %}
RUN_SHELL_COMMAND CMD=text_to_speech PARAMS="Ender 5 Print Initiated"
_BED_SAFETY_ARM

M140 S{BED_TEMP}
M104 S{EXTRUDER_STANDBY_TEMP}
G92 E0
SET_KINEMATIC_POSITION X=0 Y=0 Z=0
G90
M117 Homing
G28 x=1 y=1
Attach_Probe_Lock
G28 z=1
M117 Adjust Bed Tilt
Z_TILT_ADJUST
M117 Waiting for Bed Temperature
M190 S{BED_TEMP}
M117 Generating mesh...
BED_MESH_CLEAR
BED_MESH_CALIBRATE ADAPTIVE=1
Dock_Probe_Unlock
Dock_Probe
M117 Waiting for Nozzle Tempearature HA_10
M104 S{EXTRUDER_STANDBY_TEMP}
TEMPERATURE_WAIT SENSOR=extruder MINIMUM={EXTRUDER_STANDBY_TEMP}
M104 S{EXTRUDER_TEMP}
M117 Kombing Nozzle
KOMB
TEMPERATURE_WAIT SENSOR=extruder MINIMUM={EXTRUDER_TEMP}
M117 Applying Corrections
SKEW_PROFILE LOAD=calilantern_skew_profile

RUN_SHELL_COMMAND CMD=text_to_speech PARAMS="Ender 5 Print Beginning"
M117 Purging extruder...
LINE_PURGE
_PAUSE_ON_SWITCH
M117 Printing..... HA_11

gcode_macro end_print.gcode:
RUN_SHELL_COMMAND CMD=text_to_speech PARAMS="Ender 5 Print Complete"
{% set FINAL_Z = params.FINAL_Z|default(250)|float %}

M140 S0
M104 S0
M106 S0

G91

G1 Z0.2 E-8 F2400

G1 X5 Y5 F3000

G1 Z10

G90

Attach_Probe
M117 Resetting EXCLUDE OBJECTS mesh size
EXCLUDE_OBJECT_DEFINE RESET=1

M117 That's All Folks HA_12

filament_switch_sensor switch_sensor.insert_gcode:
M117 Filament loaded
RESPOND TYPE=echo MSG='Filament Detected'

filament_motion_sensor encoder_sensor.insert_gcode:
M117 Filament motion detected
RESPOND TYPE=echo MSG='Filament Motion Detected'

gcode_macro pause_after_d.description: Pause print after extruding D mm more filament

gcode_macro cancel_delayed_pause.gcode:
UPDATE_DELAYED_GCODE ID=PAUSE_AT_D DURATION=0
SET_GCODE_VARIABLE MACRO=PAUSE_AFTER_D VARIABLE=end_d VALUE=0
M117 Delayed pause cancelled
RESPOND TYPE=echo MSG='Delayed pause cancelled'

gcode_macro _timelapse_new_frame.description: action call for timelapse shoot. must be a seperate macro

delayed_gcode _hyperlapse_loop.gcode:
UPDATE_DELAYED_GCODE ID=_HYPERLAPSE_LOOP DURATION={printer["gcode_macro HYPERLAPSE"].cycle}
TIMELAPSE_TAKE_FRAME HYPERLAPSE=True

gcode_macro timelapse_render.description: Render Timelapse video and wait for the result

gcode_macro test_stream_delay.description: Helper macro to find stream and park delay

gcode_macro excitate_axis_at_freq.description: Maintain a specified excitation frequency for a period of time to diagnose and locate a source of vibrations

gcode_macro axes_map_calibration.description: Perform a set of movements to measure the orientation of the accelerometer and help you set the best axes_map configuration for your printer

gcode_macro compare_belts_responses.description: Perform a custom half-axis test to analyze and compare the frequency profiles of individual belts on CoreXY or CoreXZ printers

gcode_macro axes_shaper_calibration.description: Perform standard axis input shaper tests on one or both XY axes to select the best input shaper filter

gcode_macro create_vibrations_profile.description: Run a series of motions to find speed/angle ranges where the printer could be exposed to VFAs to optimize your slicer speed profiles and TMC driver parameters

gcode_macro attach_probe_lock.description: Attaches Klicky Probe, can only be docked after unlocking

gcode_macro dock_probe_unlock.description: Docks Klicky Probe even if it was locked

gcode_macro _probe_unlock.gcode:
_KlickyDebug msg="_Probe_Lock setting probe_lock variable to False"
SET_GCODE_VARIABLE MACRO=_Probe_Variables VARIABLE=probe_lock VALUE={ False }

gcode_macro _probe_lock.gcode:
_KlickyDebug msg="_Probe_Lock setting probe_lock variable to True"
SET_GCODE_VARIABLE MACRO=_Probe_Variables VARIABLE=probe_lock VALUE={ True }

gcode_macro probe_calibrate.description: Calibrate the probes z_offset with klicky automount

gcode_macro probe_accuracy.description: Probe Z-height accuracy at current XY position with klicky automount

gcode_macro bed_mesh_calibrate.description: Perform Mesh Bed Leveling with klicky automount

gcode_macro _komb_variables.gcode: { action_respond_info(" Running the KOMB_Variables macro does nothing, it is only used for storing settings :) ") }

gcode_macro _komb_trigger.description: add this macro to your slicer to enable frequency triggering.

gcode_macro _filter_fan_on.gcode:
M118 ** Running FILTER_FAN_ON macro
UPDATE_DELAYED_GCODE ID=STOP_FAN DURATION=0
SET_FAN_SPEED FAN=FILTER_fan SPEED=1

gcode_macro _filter_fan_off.gcode:
M118 ** Running FILTER_FAN_OFF macro
SET_FAN_SPEED FAN=FILTER_fan SPEED=0

gcode_macro _start_fan_timer.gcode:
{% set time = params.TIME|default(1800)|float %}
UPDATE_DELAYED_GCODE ID=STOP_FAN DURATION={time}

gcode_macro wait_for_enclosure_temp.description: TTS notify when the enclosure (combined_frame) reaches TARGET (default 40C).

gcode_macro publish_alert.gcode:
{% set data = params.PAYLOAD|default(None) %}
{action_call_remote_method("publish_mqtt_topic",
topic="klipper/gcode",
payload=data,
qos=0,
retain=False,
use_prefix=True)}

gcode_macro g28.description: G28 wrapper retained for Klicky homing after removing klipper-macros.

gcode_macro _load_filament.description: Load and purge filament after a manual swap.

gcode_macro m600.gcode:
PAUSE X={printer.toolhead.axis_maximum.x / 2} Y={printer.toolhead.axis_minimum.y + 5}
RESPOND PREFIX=KSWAP MSG="EVENT=M600"
